title: Unbounded Coin Combinations
summary: Return the number of order-independent ways reusable coin values can form amount.
statement: Return the number of order-independent ways reusable coin values can form amount. Implement `unbounded_coin_combinations` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Processing coin types outside the amount loop avoids counting different orders separately.
For each distinct coin, add ways from amount-coin into larger amounts.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the unbounded_coin_combinations invariant is complete.
Editorial: For each distinct coin, add ways from amount-coin into larger amounts. The intended bounds are O(amount·coins) time and O(amount) space.
